"""Independent brute force cross-check of the envelope and ageing."""
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import para, topo, algo

def brute_ageing(F, p, dst, x1, delta):
    """Sum the receiver drift interval by interval (no prefix sums)."""
    T = F.T; P = F.P
    total = 0
    # interval [x1, delta*T)
    x = x1
    while x < delta*T:
        m = x // T
        nxt = min((m+1)*T, delta*T)
        rate = F.rate[(p+m) % P][dst]
        total += rate * (nxt - x)
        x = nxt
    return total

def brute_envelope(F, guard):
    """Bellman-Ford style fixed point over (bound, age) lexicographic pairs."""
    P,N,T,S = F.P,F.N,F.T,F.S
    V = P*N
    # state: (bound, age) ; start from anchors
    INF = None
    bnd = [[None]*N for _ in range(P)]
    age = [[0]*N for _ in range(P)]
    changed = True
    rounds = 0
    while changed and rounds < 10*P*N+10:
        changed = False
        rounds += 1
        for p in range(P):
            for i in range(N):
                if bnd[p][i] is None: continue
                b = bnd[p][i]; a = age[p][i]
                # wait
                q = (p+1)%P
                nb = b + F.rate[p][i]*T; na = a+1
                if bnd[q][i] is None or (nb,na) < (bnd[q][i], age[q][i]):
                    bnd[q][i], age[q][i] = nb, na; changed = True
                # hops
                rho_p = F.rho[p]
                if rho_p < guard: continue
                for (dst, delta, cost, code, delay) in F.edges[p].get(i,()):
                    if rho_p + delay + guard > S: continue
                    q = (p+delta)%P
                    nb = b + cost; na = a + delta
                    if bnd[q][dst] is None or (nb,na) < (bnd[q][dst], age[q][dst]):
                        bnd[q][dst], age[q][dst] = nb, na; changed = True
    return bnd, age

def check(fabric, prof, verbose=True):
    cal = para.Calibration(prof)
    F = topo.Fabric(fabric, cal)
    ok = True
    # ageing cross-check
    for p in range(F.P):
        for lid in F.slices[F.slice_of[p]]:
            link = F.links[lid]
            for direction in (0,1):
                delay = link['delay_ns'][direction]; defer = link['defer_rounds'][direction]
                dst = link['ends'][1-direction][0]
                x1 = F.rho[p] + delay
                delta = (x1 + F.T - 1)//F.T + defer
                a1 = F.ageing(p, dst, x1, delta)
                a2 = brute_ageing(F, p, dst, x1, delta)
                if a1 != a2:
                    print('AGEING MISMATCH', p, lid, direction, a1, a2); ok = False
    # envelope cross-check
    for g in F.guards:
        b1,a1,pv,pk = algo.envelope(F, g)
        b2,a2 = brute_envelope(F, g)
        for p in range(F.P):
            for i in range(F.N):
                v = p*F.N+i
                if b1[v] != b2[p][i] or a1[v] != a2[p][i]:
                    print('ENVELOPE MISMATCH g=%s p=%s i=%s'%(g,p,i), b1[v], b2[p][i], a1[v], a2[p][i]); ok=False
    if verbose: print('verify ok' if ok else 'FAILURES')
    return ok
PYEOF
